extremum_reference_schema.note: float64 upstream outputs (history.prior_high/low, daily_observations.high/low) are rounded and are NOT accepted as inputs; the I/O layer maps the exact integer coefficients (decision DP-R6).

mathematics.notation: closes C, highs H, lows L are positive integer coefficients at one scale s; V is int64 shares >= 0; epoch bars a..t (a anchor, t target); empty = proven zero-volume slot
mathematics.mfm: MFM_i = (2C_i - H_i - L_i) / (H_i - L_i) in [-1, 1]; 0 when H_i == L_i
mathematics.obv: OBV[a] = 0; base = last priced close at or before i-1 (none -> increment 0 and this bar becomes the base); OBV[i] = OBV[i-1] + sign(C_i - base) * V_i; empty slots add 0 and never become the base; ties add 0; published int64, OVERFLOW refusal if outside int64
mathematics.ad_line: AD[t] = sum_{i=a..t} MFM_i * V_i as an exact rational, published float(Fraction) once, +0.0 for zero
mathematics.cmf: CMF[t] = sum_{i=t-N+1..t} MFM_i * V_i / sum V_i; N governed slots wholly inside the epoch (t-N+1 >= a else insufficient_history); sum V == 0 -> null, not_applicable/zero_denominator
mathematics.retracement: R = H - L; from_high: level = (H - r*R)/10^s; from_low: level = (L + r*R)/10^s; r = ratio_num/ratio_den exact; published float(Fraction) once; H == L -> zero_denominator; H < L -> ineligible
mathematics.overflow: OBV int64 bound only; |AD| < 2^76, CMF in [-1,1] and retracement level in [L,H]/10^s are always finite float64

quality.rule: all applicable reasons retained in lexical order; status follows the first applicable reason in precedence

counts.obv_ad_line: expected = t-a+1, observed = ready (priced or proven-empty) slots
counts.cmf: expected = N, observed = ready slots inside max(a, t-N+1)..t
counts.retracement: expected 2, observed = sides admitted causal with a non-null positive price

evidence.limit: config parameter evidence_limit, integer 0..10000 (R17 _context.py: build config integer(evidence_limit, 0, 10000)); witnesses never exceed it

mode_rule: anchored reset batch only (carry mode out of v1); known_at and reconstruction availability modes give identical results; update, restore and merge unsupported; batch and full replay only
fixture_notation: compact, NOT canonical wire. Money flow: scale 2 coefficients; slots a..t with state priced (c,h,l,v,known_at), empty (proven zero volume), absent (no row, no coverage), gap (declared incomplete coverage), unknown (known_at null), future (known_at 150 > K 100). K=100, known_at 50 when not stated. Float results list exact rational, float64 and float.hex. Retracement: price coefficients at the stated scale; side states priced, absent, empty_batch, null_price, insufficient (factor [observed, required]), unknown, future, gap. Money-flow slot state null_volume: a row whose volume is null. A fixture with a selected list evaluates only those outputs.

money_flow_fixtures.description: anchor only (t=a): OBV exact initial 0; AD = MFV of the anchor; CMF N=1 equals the anchor multiplier
anchor only, CMF N=3 -> insufficient history (expected 3, observed 1); OBV and AD still available
two bars, N=3: CMF still insufficient (observed 2)
t-a+1 == N exactly: CMF becomes available at the first possible bar (boundary equality)
up, down, tie, up: signed volume, tie adds 0, first bar contributes 0
constant series (all closes equal, ranges nonzero): OBV exactly 0, AD/CMF from multiplier 0
strictly rising closes: OBV = sum of volumes from a+1
strictly falling closes: OBV negative
tie after a move then move back: tie compares against the immediately preceding priced close, not an extremum
close at high (multiplier +1) then close at low (-1): CMF exactly 0 over equal volumes; AD 0
close at high on all bars: CMF exactly +1.0
close at low on all bars: CMF exactly -1.0
zero-range bar (H==L==C) inside the window: multiplier 0 by convention, volume still in the denominator
every bar zero range: AD = +0.0 and CMF = +0.0 (positive volume, numerator zero), OBV from closes
non-representable multipliers: AD and CMF single correctly rounded float64
large int64 volumes: exact rational sums, one rounding
proven-empty (zero-volume) slot mid-epoch: contributes 0 flow; OBV base stays the last priced close
empty anchor slot: the first priced bar is the OBV base and contributes 0
CMF window entirely empty: denominator zero -> null, not_applicable/zero_denominator; OBV and AD stay available
every slot empty: OBV 0, AD +0.0, CMF zero_denominator
partly empty window: empty slot counts in the window length but adds 0 to both sums
window rolls past the anchor: CMF uses only the last N bars while AD/OBV use the whole epoch
anchor asymmetry: the large anchor volume is excluded from OBV (no prior close) but included in AD
absent slot inside the epoch: OBV and AD missing_input/absent_input; CMF window after it independent and available
absent slot inside the CMF window: CMF missing_input/absent_input with observed < expected
declared incomplete coverage slot: incomplete_coverage/governed_gap, no auto recovery
unknown known_at slot: missing_input/unknown_availability
future-known slot (known_at > K): missing_input/future_knowledge, its values cannot influence any output
mixed absent + future + gap: all reasons retained in lexical order, status follows precedence (missing_input)
gap and insufficient history together (CMF): governed_gap outranks insufficient_history
future slot older than the CMF window does not affect CMF
OBV exactly int64 max (2^63-1): available
OBV exactly int64 min (-2^63): available
same input as refusal MR20 (published OBV would be 2^63): with only ad_line and cmf selected there is no OBV overflow and both are available

null volume (as opposed to 0) on a row: missing input, null_field, the slot is not ready (never assumed empty or zero flow); OBV and AD missing_input/null_field, CMF too when the slot is in its window
intermediate excursion beyond int64 that returns in range: only the published value is bounded; AD stays within float64

DP-M1.decision: OBV starts at 0 at the anchor.

DP-M3.decision: OBV base is the last priced close; empty slots never become the base.

DP-M5.decision: Zero-volume slots count as zero flow only when coverage proves them empty (differs from R17 EMA/ATR blocking, see above).

DP-M6.decision: CMF is the plain ratio of window sums over the last N slots; N caller-set, no default.

DP-M7.decision: Zero CMF volume sum is null, `not_applicable/zero_denominator`.

DP-M8.decision: A/D includes the anchor bar; OBV excludes the anchor bar's volume.

DP-M9.decision: Exact rationals with one float64 rounding; OBV exact int64 with `OVERFLOW` refusal.

DP-R1.decision: One output per config, direction in config.

DP-R3.decision: Free reduced rational ratio in [0,1], no default.

DP-R5.decision: `H < L` or a non-positive coefficient is `ineligible`.

DP-R6.decision: Exact integer-coefficient extrema; rounded float64 rejected.

DP-R7.decision: Window length belongs to the extrema owner, carried as `factor_den`, equal across roles.

DP-R8.decision: No close price in the level.

DP-R9.decision: Shortfall is a null price with `factor_num < factor_den`.
